pageDesc: We're a group of indie developers passionate about building the best IndieStack template.

story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: IndieStack was born from a simple idea: indie developers should be able to launch SaaS projects quickly without reinventing the wheel. We know how much time and effort it takes to build a modern SaaS app from scratch, including auth, billing, team management, and more.

So we created IndieStack—a carefully crafted, production-ready IndieStack. It integrates all common features into a unified codebase, so you can focus on building what truly matters: your business logic.
After hundreds of hours of development and iteration, IndieStack is now a complete, battle-tested platform that has helped thousands of developers worldwide launch their SaaS projects quickly.

items.title: Developer Experience First
items.description: We believe great tools should make development enjoyable. Every detail is polished, from code quality to documentation.

items.title: Production Ready
items.description: We don't ship half-baked products. Every feature is thoroughly tested to ensure reliable operation in production.

items.title: Continuous Iteration
items.description: The tech world evolves rapidly. We continuously update and optimize to keep IndieStack using best practices and latest technologies.

items.title: Open & Transparent
items.description: We believe in the power of open source. Code is fully open, and community contributions drive our improvement.
